lead: Repetitive tasks take more than time. Each one pulls your attention away from customers, cases and decisions that really need your involvement. Automation takes over part of that routine so you can return to more important work.

sections.heading: Less repetition in everyday work
sections.text: Moving information between tools, copying data, preparing documents and keeping track of the next steps — many of these tasks can be automated. I first look at how you work, then choose a solution for the process you want to remove or simplify.

sections.heading: From two hours to five minutes
sections.text: An implementation at a law firm reduced the time needed for some tasks from around two hours to five minutes. It is a concrete example of the difference the right automation can make — results depend on the task and the process.

sections.heading: Automation should reduce your workload
sections.text: I look for work that repeats in the same form and assess which steps can safely be handled by a system. We agree on the scope, I implement the solution and hand it over in a way that is clear and convenient for everyday use. You and your team stay in control of anything that needs human judgement.
